description.value: Ragazzi Pizza Co. is an East Vancouver neighbourhood pizzeria specializing in hand-stretched, stone-baked authentic Italian pizza made with traditional dough prepared on-site and premium imported ingredients. The restaurant offers dine-in, takeout, and delivery, as well as a catering service and food truck for events ranging from weddings to school lunch programs. It is a well-established local fixture in the Kensington–Cedar Cottage area serving a wide range of classic and vegetarian Italian pies.

address.value: 2996 East 22nd Avenue E, Vancouver, BC V5M 2Y4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms dine-in, takeout, and delivery service, matching OSM tags (takeaway=yes, delivery=yes). Vegetarian options are confirmed both by OSM (diet:vegetarian=yes) and the website's dedicated vegetarian pizza section with multiple 🥬-marked items. Neither the website nor OSM tags mention bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities, so those remain null. A discrepancy exists between OSM opening hours (closed Monday) and the website contact page which states 'Open 7 days a week.'
concerns: Opening hours discrepancy: OSM tags show the restaurant is closed on Mondays (Tu–Su only), but the website contact page states 'Open 7 days a week'. Prefer the website's claim as more current, but recommend verification.
Street address in OSM lacks city/province/postal code; full civic address could not be confirmed from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Ragazzi Pizza Co. is a legitimate, active East Vancouver restaurant well-suited as a food stop for touring cyclists, but the key required criterion of bike parking or visibility is unconfirmed from available evidence and requires an on-the-ground or photographic check before inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website mentions a food truck in addition to the brick-and-mortar location; if the food truck operates at separate locations it may warrant a distinct OSM/directory entry.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website lists multiple vegetarian-friendly pizzas (marked 🥬) including Originale, Margherita, Marinara, Primavera, Vegetariano, Quattro Formaggi, and others. No vegan or GF options mentioned
